title: TEA-Sim: Reproducibility package for standards-compatible trust-evidence interface simulation

creators.name: Clim, Antonio
creators.affiliation: Department of Economic Informatics and Cybernetics, Bucharest University of Economic Studies

description: Reproducibility package for a standards-compatible TrustEvidence interface simulation. Version v1.5.1 is a patch release that removes local bytecode artefacts and preserves the script-generated figure pipeline. No identifiable clinical data, FHIR server, blockchain deployment or cryptographic runtime benchmark is included. Version DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21134217.
